scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && sleep 5 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U default -d verceldb -c "INSERT INTO \"user\" (id, name, email, email_verified, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'Demo User', 'demo@example.com', true, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;"
